milestones.role: Co-taught the course with community and faculty partners. Student participation is a course-specific count, not a measure of wider community impact.

milestones.title: Co-authored U.S. coastal population and settlement analysis
milestones.summary: Co-authored a Geomatica study comparing global population grids with U.S. census-based data to understand coastal exposure and how data choices affect local resilience assessments.
milestones.role: Co-author, with credited contributions in data, methods, analysis and writing.

milestones.title: Contributed to EnvClim Grids
milestones.summary: Named among the contributors to EnvClim Grids, a released global dataset combining urban environmental vulnerability and future climate risk on an approximately 500-metre grid.
milestones.role: Acknowledged contributor in the official dataset record. The record lists the dataset's authors separately and does not specify individual tasks for the acknowledged contributors.

milestones.title: Built the USGRIDS 2020 scientific review atlas
milestones.summary: Built a public scientific atlas for coauthor review of the corrected 2020 U.S. Census allocated-grid release candidate. The interface organizes geographic selections, demographic variables and existing map views while the formal dataset publication remains pending.
milestones.role: Developed the atlas and incorporated coauthor review. The repository identifies a proposed dataset author team; its citation and DOI remain provisional.
